spec_match.rationale: The page still demonstrates real :playing, :paused, and :muted selectors on an audio element, with the visual layer driven by CSS rather than class toggles.

interactive.rationale: Chrome DevTools MCP verified that generated audio plays in HeadlessChrome/150, but all three exact selector checks are false there and no visual state activates. Chrome for Testing 152.0.7977.2 also reports the selectors false by default and true only with --enable-blink-features=CSSMediaElementPseudos. Native play/pause/mute visuals still require MCP validation in that exact flagged build.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The copy now accurately says the audio is generated in-page and playable, while the CSS explanation separates Web Audio source generation from pseudo-class visuals.

edge_cases.rationale: The page now feature-detects the exact :playing/:paused/:muted selectors, identifies the current CSSMediaElementPseudos flag when unavailable, keeps audio usable, and exposes an explicit non-visual disabled state instead of promising an effect that cannot run.

references.rationale: The page includes ChromeStatus, MDN, and Selectors Level 4 references.

design_system.rationale: The new status text uses existing typography and design variables without adding raw color styling.

runtime_evidence.rationale: The previous claim of a Chrome DevTools MCP v152 pass was not backed by retained session evidence and contradicted the current experimental runtime flag. The unsupported path is verified; the enabled native path remains blocked until MCP can launch Chrome 152 with CSSMediaElementPseudos.

conformance.rationale: A v152 suite now carries the same feature-ID/spec contract without modifying the immutable source-milestone suite.

openQuestions.title: Validate native media pseudo-class visuals in flagged Chrome 152
openQuestions.detail: Launch Chrome 152 through chrome-devtools-mcp with --enable-blink-features=CSSMediaElementPseudos, then verify play glow/status, pause title opacity/status, mute strike-through, desktop/mobile layout, console, network, and saved screenshots. Do not promote runtime_evidence or interactive to pass without that session-bound evidence.

guidanceConsulted.query: style media elements with playing paused seeking pseudo-classes and visible glow state changes
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use progressive enhancement and expose unsupported experimental CSS states explicitly rather than substituting a fake visual result.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: exact selector detection controls truthful support copy; native CSS remains the only mechanism for the glow/title/mute visuals; unsupported browsers receive text and exact flag instructions, not JS-toggled imitation states.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: modern-web-guidance search on 2026-07-29; Chrome DevTools MCP HeadlessChrome/150 unsupported-path interaction; Chromium runtime_enabled_features.json5 main marks CSSMediaElementPseudos experimental; Chrome for Testing 152.0.7977.2 command-line selector probe false by default and true with the exact flag.

summary: Corrected a false runtime claim: the media pseudo-classes remain experimental in current Chromium and require --enable-blink-features=CSSMediaElementPseudos in Chrome 152. The demo now detects disabled selectors and fails closed with exact launch guidance. Native flagged play/pause/mute visuals remain explicitly unverified by MCP.
